# Options with which the ready-made parsers of the alpha-parsers repository are generated from the grammars in this
# directory: <name> <sxir gen options>. The parser sizes of the deterministic metrics (bench/metrics) generate the
# parsers with them.
cel -types -typed-only -no-limits -nodoc -lib import
csv -types -recognize -nodoc -lib import
cue -types -typed-only -no-limits -nodoc -lib import
duckdb -types -typed-only -no-limits -nodoc -lib import
golang -expectations -types -typed-only -no-limits -nodoc -lib import
json -types -recognize -nodoc -lib import
python -expectations -types -typed-only -no-limits -nodoc -lib import
typescript -expectations -types -typed-only -no-limits -nodoc -lib import
xml -expectations -types -recognize -nodoc -lib import
yaml -types -recognize -nodoc -lib import
